_meta.description: Tags for named recurring locations in NR — tunnels, catacombs, sites of grace landmarks, etc. Parallel to nr_starting_encampments.json but for mid-expedition POIs that Alaric refers to by name during playtest reports. Used to (a) annotate spoiler entries with `in_named_location: {category, slug}` for CTD correlation, (b) provide stable terminology between Alaric and Claude when discussing specific locations, (c) optionally feed into oops_all_nb_marker_scope as a placement-pin scope in the future.
_meta.tagging_unit: MSB-level — every Part in a listed MSB is considered part of the named location. Same constraint as starting_encampments: works because each named asset MSB has a single instantiation in any given expedition. If a future data point shows the same MSB being shared between multiple named locations, will need to refine to (msb, pi-range).

schema.slug: Stable identifier for the location (snake_case). Used in spoiler annotation.
schema.label: Human-readable name as Alaric refers to it
schema.description: Vanilla composition, layout hints, anything useful for CTD investigation
schema.vanilla_composition: Map of chr_prefix → count of vanilla parts using that chr
schema.ctd_history: List of past CTD reports tied to this location

_meta.maintained_by: manual — entries added as Alaric identifies recurring locations he references in playtests

m43_50_00_00.msb.label: Digger Tunnel (Limveld Shallow Lake)
m43_50_00_00.msb.description: Lake-adjacent tunnel asset. Vanilla composition: 6 c4381 Diggers (Guilty/Glintstone Digger variant). Entrance has 4 visible guys at Y=0-2; deeper interior slots at Y=-11 and Y=-37 (subterranean). The lake-adjacent geometry may cause emerge animation CTDs for chrs placed at entrance level (Y=0-2) since 'subsurface terrain' may not be solid earth there. Identified as 'the digger tunnel' by Alaric — when he says 'tunnel' he typically means this location.
m43_50_00_00.msb.geometry_notes: Tunnel entrance at Y=0-2 (level ground), then descends to Y=-11 (pi=5) and Y=-37 (pi=2). Likely instantiated near the Limveld shallow lake in m60 tiles, making the entrance geometry potentially water-adjacent.

ctd_history.symptom: CTD on tunnel entry after stable Day 1
ctd_history.resolution: v0.24.85 — banned emerge_from_ground at pi=0,1,2,3,4 (the entrance + near-entrance slots; pi=5 left unblocked since Y=-11 is deep enough for emerge to work)
